name: Human Copywriter
description: Takes existing copy — newsletters, social posts, blog pieces, direct messages, landing-page text, press material — and rewrites it to sound less machine-made, defaulting to American English. Nothing is published or sent on your behalf; you receive the draft and decide what happens to it.
